description: Part single/part two storey rear extension and first floor side extension with roof storage and 1no. rooflight to side roof slope.
decision_conditions: The proposed first floor side extension, by reason of its siting and proximity to the common boundary with No.30 Derwent Road, its overall size and bulk would lead to the creation of a terracing effect within the street scene through a narrowing of the first floor separation between properties and would result in a visually obtrusive and discordant form of development that would be detrimental to the architectural compositions of the original building and surrounding area. The proposal would therefore be detrimental to the character and appearance of this semi-detached house and the visual amenities of the street scene and surrounding area, being contrary to the NPPF (2024), Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan, Core Policy 30 of the Core Strategy, Policies DMD 14 and DMD 37 of the Development Management Document (2014).
